---
## generating random variables

- 常用離散機率分配（Discrete Probability Distributions），如：binomial、geometric、Poisson。

- 連續機率分配（Continuous Probability Distributions），如：uniform、normal、exponential。

- R 語言中機率分配的指令有固定的 pattern，以二項分配（binomial）為例，指令的第一個字分別為：`d` 為機率密度函數（PDF）、 `p` 為累積分配函數（CDF）、 `q` 為百分位數（quantile） 、 `r` 為隨機抽樣。
```{r eval=F}
dbinom(x, size, prob, log = FALSE)
pbinom(q, size, prob, lower.tail = TRUE, log.p = FALSE)
qbinom(p, size, prob, lower.tail = TRUE, log.p = FALSE)
rbinom(n, size, prob)
```

---
## Probability Mass Function

#### 二項分配：
$$f(x)=C_{x}^{n} p_{}^{x} (1-p)_{}^{n-x}$$
#### $X \sim {\sf Binom}(10, 0.2)$ 當 x = 0 時，此時機率分配為：
$$f(0)=C_{0}^{10} (0.2)_{}^{0} (1-0.2)_{}^{10-0}$$

```{r}
dbinom(x = 0, size = 10, prob = 0.2) # 參數名稱皆能省略
```

---
## Probability Mass Function
#### vistributions 套件可用來視覺化機率分布（Probability distributions）。
```{r fig1, fig.show = 'hide', message=FALSE}
library(vistributions)
vdist_binom_prob(n = 10, p = 0.2, s = 0, type = "exact")
```
```{r ref.label='fig1', echo = FALSE, out.width="45%", fig.align='center', message=FALSE}
```

---
## Cumulative Distribution Function

#### 累積分配函數（Cumulative Distribution Function, CDF）

$$ F_{x}(x)=P(X \le x) $$

```{r}
pbinom(q = 2, size = 10, prob = 0.2) # 參數名稱皆能省略
```

#### $F_{x}(x)=P(X \le 10)$ 累積分配函數總和為 1 

```{r}
pbinom(q = 10, size = 10, prob = 0.2) 
```

---
## Cumulative Distribution Function

```{r out.width="55%", fig.align='center'}
vdist_binom_prob(n = 10, p = 0.2, c(0, 2), type = "interval")
```
---
## Quantiles

```{r}
qbinom(p = 0.5, size = 10, prob = 0.2)
```

```{r out.width="45%", fig.align='center'}
vdist_binom_perc(n = 10, p = 0.2, tp = 0.5)
```

## generating random variables

#### $X \sim {\sf Binom}(10, 0.2)$，隨機抽取 8 個樣本：
```{r}
rbinom(n = 8, size = 10, prob = 0.2)
```
- 如果要確保每次抽樣都獲得同樣的樣本，可以用 `set.seed()` 來確保特定隨機序列，以產生相同的隨機樣本。
- 在 `set.seed()` 指定一組數字，每次抽樣前先執行以確保產生相同抽樣結果。

```{r}
set.seed(20260513)
rbinom(n = 8, size = 10, prob = 0.2)
```


---
## Probability Density Function

#### 常態分配：
$$ f_X(x) = \frac{1}{\sigma \sqrt{2\pi}} e^{ -\frac{(x - \mu)^2}{2\sigma^2} } $$

#### $X \sim {\sf N}(0, 1)$ 當 x = 0 時，此時機率分配為：
$$ f_X(0) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} $$
```{r}
dnorm(x = 0, mean = 0, sd = 1) # 參數名稱皆能省略
```

## Probability Density Function

```{r out.width="55%", fig.align='center'}
vdist_normal_plot(mean = 0, sd = 1)
```

## Cumulative Distribution Function

#### 標準常態分配，累積分配函數（Cumulative Distribution Function, CDF）
$$F(Z) = \mathrm{P}(-\infty \le Z \le \infty)$$

#### Finding Upper Tail Probabilities：
$$\mathrm{P}(Z \ge 1.62)$$
```{r}
pnorm(q = 1.62, mean = 0, sd = 1)
```
---
## Cumulative Distribution Function
```{r out.width="55%", fig.align='center'}

```

---
### The Normal Approximation to the Binomial

.middle_block[
#### 利用常態分配來近似二項分配，則 $\mu=np$ 、 $\sigma^2=np(1-p)$ ；

$$ {\sf Binom}(20, 0.5) \\approx {\sf N}(10, (\sqrt{5})^2) $$
```{r eval=F, out.width="55%", fig.align='center'}
set.seed(20260513)
u <- rbinom(10000, 20, 0.5)
x <- seq(0, 20, length = 10000)
y <- dnorm(x, 20*0.5, sqrt(5))
hist(u, breaks = seq(-0.5, 20.5, by = 1), prob = T, ylim = c(0, 0.2))
lines(x, y, col = 'red')
```
]
---
### The Normal Approximation to the Binomial
```{r echo=F, out.width="55%", fig.align='center'}
set.seed(20260513)
u <- rbinom(10000, 20, 0.5)
x <- seq(0, 20, length = 10000)
y <- dnorm(x, mean = 20*0.5, sd = sqrt(5))
hist(u, breaks = seq(-0.5, 20.5, by = 1), prob = T, ylim = c(0, 0.2))
lines(x, y, col = 'red')
```

## Hypothesis Testing

.middle_block[
|                      | **Researcher**                     |               |
|----------------------|:----------------------------------:|--------------:|
| **Null Hypothesis**  | *Do Not Reject* $H_0$              | *Reject* $H_0$ |
| $H_0$ is true        | Correct decision                   | Type I error   |
| $H_0$ is false       | Type II error                      | Correct decision |

- Type I error：虛無假設為真，且拒絕虛無假設。

- Type II error：虛無假設為非，但不拒絕虛無假設。
]
---
## Type I error

#### if $\mu=2$：
```{r echo=F, out.width='60%', fig.align='center'}
vdist_normal_perc(0.95, mean = 2, sd = 1.36, type = 'both')
```
---
## Type I error
```{r}
set.seed(20260513)
error1 <- replicate(10000, {
  x <- rnorm(30, mean = 2, sd = 1.36)
  z <- (mean(x) - 2) / (1.36 / sqrt(30))
  as.integer(abs(z) > qnorm(0.975))
})
mean(error1)
```

```{r}
error1 <- replicate(10000, {
  x <- rnorm(30, mean = 2, sd = 1.36)
  z <- (mean(x) - 2) / (1.36 / sqrt(30))
  as.integer(abs(z) > qnorm(0.975))
})
mean(error1)
```
---
## Type II error

```{r echo=F, out.width='60%', fig.align='center'}
mu0 <- 100; mu1 <- 105; sigma <- 10; n <- 25; alpha <- 0.05    

# 臨界值：z_alpha（右尾）
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha)
crit_value <- mu0 + z_alpha * (sigma / sqrt(n))  # 對應 x 的拒絕門檻

# 建立 x 軸
x <- seq(85, 120, length = 1000)

# H0 和 H1 的常態分布
f0 <- dnorm(x, mean = mu0, sd = sigma / sqrt(n))
f1 <- dnorm(x, mean = mu1, sd = sigma / sqrt(n))

# 畫圖
plot(x, f0, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "red", ylim = c(0, max(f0, f1)),
     ylab = "Density", xlab = "Sample Mean", main = "Type II Error (β) Illustration")
lines(x, f1, col = "blue", lwd = 2)

x_beta <- x[x < crit_value]
polygon(c(x_beta, rev(x_beta)),
        c(dnorm(x_beta, mean = mu1, sd = sigma / sqrt(n)), rep(0, length(x_beta))),
        col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.3), border = NA)

abline(v = crit_value, lty = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("H0: N(100)", "H1: N(105)", "Type II error (β)"),
       col = c("red", "blue", rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.3)), lty = c(1,1,NA), pch = c(NA, NA, 15))
```
---
## Type II error
```{r}
mu0 <- 100; mu1 <- 105
set.seed(20260513)
errors2 <- replicate(10000, {
  x <- rnorm(30, mean = mu1, sd = 10)
  z <- (mean(x) - mu0) / (10 / sqrt(30))
  as.integer(abs(z) <= qnorm(0.975))
})
mean(errors2)
```

## One Sample t Test
```{r}
set.seed(20260513)
sample1 <- rnorm(100, mean = 15.2, sd = 0.5)
t.test(sample1, mu = 15)
```
---
## One Sample t Test
```{r eval=F}
library(gginference)
```

```{r, out.width='50%', fig.align='center', warning=F}
ggttest(t.test(sample1, mu = 15))
```
---
## One Sample t Test
```{r}
set.seed(20260513)
sample2 <- rnorm(100, mean = 2, sd = 0.5)
t.test(sample2, mu = 2.005, alternative = "greater")
```
---
## One Sample t Test

```{r, out.width='50%', fig.align='center', warning=F}
ggttest(t.test(sample2, mu = 2.005, alternative = "greater"))
```
---
## Two Samples t Test
```{r}
set.seed(20260513)
group1 <- rnorm(100, mean = 34, sd = 6)
group2 <- rnorm(100, mean = 32, sd = 4)
t.test(group1, group2)
```
---
## Two Samples t Test
```{r, out.width='50%', fig.align='center', warning=F}
ggttest(t.test(group1, group2))
```
---
## One-way ANOVA
```{r}
set.seed(20260513)
aov_df <- data.frame(value = c(rnorm(20, mean = 30, sd = 1), 
                               rnorm(20, mean = 30.5, sd = 3),
                               rnorm(20, mean = 29.5, sd = 5)),
                     group = factor(rep(c("A", "B", "C"), each = 20)))
aov_result <- aov(value ~ group, data = aov_df)
summary(aov_result)

```

---
## One-way ANOVA
```{r, out.width='50%', fig.align='center', warning=F}
ggaov(aov_result)
```

---
## Chi-Square Test

```{r}
set.seed(20260513)
rolls <- sample(1:6, size = 90, replace = T)
chisq_result <- chisq.test(table(rolls), p = rep(1/6, 6))
chisq_result
```

---
## Chi-Square Test
```{r, out.width='50%', fig.align='center', warning=F}
ggchisqtest(chisq_result)
```
